title: Cold-transcript candidate recheck scans the whole delegation inventory and card index per candidate under the state lock
outcome: A persistence pass that rechecks finished-child candidates builds the delegation-link and card-owner lookups once per pass (or uses an existing index), so its work under StateInner is bounded by one inventory scan rather than one per candidate.
acceptance: Cold-transcript candidate recheck scans the whole delegation inventory and card index per candidate under the state lock is done
